title: A night's dream
summary: At 04:00, while you sleep, Kumo dreams: it looks back over Thursday, writes your journal for it, moves tomorrow's check on your legs to after your lie-in, and sets one for Saturday's session. It leaves a record of what it planned, noticed and saved for you, and nothing notifies. In the morning you open it, it's seen, and you take back the Saturday check; the record says so.
